marketing_description: The Leviton R12-AGTR1-0KW GFCI outlet delivers 125 V, 15 A protection with a 60 Hz frequency rating and 10 kA interrupt and short‑circuit ratings. It features a self‑grounding, thermoplastic body with brass contacts, a white color, and a back‑wired terminal for wall mounting. The unit meets NEMA 5‑15R and IP54 ratings, includes an LED indicator, and supports 14 to 10 AWG wires.
